_readme: Seed rows for the GDPR Art 30 register of processing activities.
with your real legal entities, review each lawful_basis, then load:
(or loop over this file). Rows are audited server-side; POST /ropa/{id}
upserts an existing row when a detail changes.

activities.purpose: Stores operator-supplied knowledge chunks and serves semantic recall for AI-assisted work.
activities.categories: Operator-authored knowledge content (may incidentally contain personal data); query text
activities.recipients: Authenticated principals of this deployment only
activities.security_measures: Loopback-only service, bearer-token auth, read sanitization, PII masking, per-domain tenancy

activities.purpose: Hash-chained audit log of every mutation for accountability and breach investigation.
activities.categories: Principal labels, action metadata, tenant/domain labels (no case content)
activities.recipients: Admin-role operators; supervisory authorities on request
activities.security_measures: SHA-256 hash chain, tamper verification endpoint, append-only posture

activities.purpose: Runs interview/case workflows including complaints, DSARs, handovers, and approvals.
activities.categories: Case subjects' contact data and case content as entered by operators
activities.recipients: Assigned crew principals; CRM systems via configured connectors
activities.security_measures: HITL approval gates, quarantine screening, legal holds, domain-scoped authz

activities.purpose: Mirrors cases between external CRM systems and the workflow engine.
activities.categories: CRM case records: subject references, status, case content
activities.recipients: The configured CRM vendor (see transfers register)
activities.security_measures: Scoped connector credentials, idempotent sync keys, transfer register cross-reference

activities.purpose: Publishes approved support articles as static pages for customers.
activities.categories: Published article content (no PII by construction: redaction at build)
activities.security_measures: Approval-gated publishing, unconditional PII redaction, noindex for non-public artifacts

activities.purpose: Maintains RoPA, breach, DSAR, legal-hold, and transfer registers required by GDPR.
activities.categories: Register metadata: subjects, jurisdictions, deadlines, dispositions
activities.recipients: Admin-role operators; supervisory authorities on request
activities.lawful_basis: Legal obligation (GDPR Arts 30, 33, 34; Ch V transfers)
